diameterInterpretation: Updated convex DAMIT shape at an approximate 147 km scale transferred from a published thermophysical model (±2 km for that source fit; additional uncertainty for this model). The old preliminary spin solution is not used. Grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Published uncertainty on SAGE-based thermophysical diameter; not the total uncertainty of transferring that size to a different convex mesh.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Volume-equivalent diameter 147±2 km from Alí-Lagoa et al.2020Table2 (SAGE1, HerschelPACS). The selected DAMIT16321 is a different convex model, so using this physical scale is explicitly approximate.
calibration.reference: Alí-Lagoa et al.(2020), A&A638,A84, Table 2, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202037718; SAGE model reference Podlewska-Gaca et al.(2020), A&A638,A11
calibration.limitations: Published 147±2 km uncertainty belongs to the SAGE1thermophysical solution, not a scale fit to DAMIT16321. Neither SAGE mirror pole was rejected by the thermaldata. The original SAGE archive was surveyed but not retrievable during intake; no morphology transfer or replacement method is invented. LatestDAMIT16321source period 8.0975859h and pole 304.1°,63.7° are preserved, but absolute phase remains illustrative.
calibration.sourceLabel: Alí-Lagoa et al.(2020), A&A638,A84, Table 2, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202037718; SAGE model reference Podlewska-Gaca et al.(2020), A&A638,A11
